clips.title: The story
paras: Southeast of Darkshire, Tranquil Gardens Cemetery is overrun by shambling skeletons and ghouls. The former burial site has become an immediate hazard for the nearby town.

Tranquil Gardens Cemetery was once a quiet resting place for the departed of Grand Hamlet. Dark curses settled over Duskwood, and the dead buried here began clawing their way out of their plots. Skeletal warriors, skeletal mages, and wandering undead haunt the gravestones. Though relatively weak beside the horrors deeper in the woods, they pose a relentless threat to townsfolk so close to Darkshire.

Tranquil Gardens Cemetery lies close to Darkshire's edge, making it the Night Watch's frontline. The Watch often sends fresh recruits and arriving adventurers to cull the rising dead before they reach the settlement. More dangerous threats, such as the Insane Ghoul, lurk among the tumbled headstones and the ruined chapel.
